b'# tinydl

A small command line downloader: it fetches a URL and writes the data to a file or to stdout. It retries failed downloads up to 3 times with a 20-second timeout per attempt.

## Usage

```
tinydl URL [-o OUTPUT] [-q]
```

## Command line options

| Option | Help text |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |
'
